parent_finding: F-19 (modem-wmi-xref.md): b23/b24 skipped as 'packed/compressed, contents unverified'
question: Do WMI-like values in modem.b23/b24 live in decompressible/literal regions or hidden compressed payloads? Does the F-19 modem NO verdict change?
verdict_basis: b24 is not packed at all (87% all-zero fill, max block entropy 7.5, all data literal, 147 distinct values fully accounted for in literal regions). b23 = 745 KB literal islands (99 distinct values, same generic families) + 38.9 MB opaque body with no container magic, no chunk table, no strings, isolated WMI-like hits (0/71 with WMI-like neighbors), and a compressed-token-like 16-bit profile; its hits are consistent with compression artifacts of the same generic QC constant families already neutralized by the adsp.b36 control.

decompression.q6zip_evidence: q6z/Q6Z/ZIC hits at chance level; no chunk table; format unidentified (proprietary, q6zip-like suspected by profile only)

b24_r5.note: dense binary, entropy <=7.3, gibberish-only strings, verdict-neutral

b23_opaque_body_tests.extent: 38.9 MB (all entropy-H blocks outside the two mid islands)

value_0x4004.note: 6 of 20 in literal mid1 (0x22b62f0..0x22b9b20, clustered); 14 isolated in body

b23_opaque_body_tests.interpretation: compressed-token artifacts, not stored dispatch constants (isolation + gibberish contexts + no strings + partial-skew profile); worst-case-literal fallback still lands in generic control-matched families

comparison_to_f19.b24_provenance: fully literal; F-19's 177 names fully inside verifiable bytes
comparison_to_f19.b23_provenance: 99 distinct values / 441 hits in the two literal islands; remainder in opaque body, artifact-consistent

notes: Extracted regions kept in /tmp only; no binary committed. Scripts one-off in /tmp/scripts. Honest negative: b23 body decompression yield 0 bytes; verdict rests on structural tests, not payload decryption.
